neighbours.label: comma or 'and' ending a timed instruction step before the next action (recipes, exercises)
fire: Stir the sauce over low heat for ten minutes, adding water if it thickens.
Knead the dough on a floured board for 8 minutes, then cover it with a towel.
Bake the cake for 35 minutes, rotating the pan halfway through.
Repeat the stretch ten times on each side, then rest for a minute.
Fry the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes.
Whisk the eggs and milk together, then pour into the hot pan.
Hold the plank for one minute, breathing slowly through your nose.
Simmer the beans for an hour, skimming off any foam.
quiet: The sauce was thick and rich, and the guests loved it.
The dough recipe comes from my grandmother, who lived in Naples.
